description: Sends eight control voltages out as Open Sound Control messages and turns eight incoming messages back into control voltages

params.text: Turns the connection on and saves the addresses and ports typed into the configuration screen
Shows and hides the configuration screen where the addresses and ports are typed
Switched on, the connection is opened again whenever the patch is loaded
Keeps the channel settings that were edited and returns to the main configuration screen
Throws away the channel settings that were edited and returns to the main configuration screen
Switched on, the channel being configured maps its voltage range onto the value range instead of sending the raw voltage
Switched on, a voltage outside the channel's range is pulled back to the nearest end rather than mapped past it
Moves the configuration screen one expander to the left, towards the input expanders
Moves the configuration screen one expander to the right, towards the output expanders
Picks which block of eight channels the configuration screen is showing, for an expander that carries more than eight
Numbers the channels of the expander being configured again, from its place in the chain
Opens the settings for that input channel, where its address and value range are set
Opens the settings for that output channel, where its address and value range are set

inputs.text: A rising edge here sends that channel's value out as a message
The voltage that channel sends; a polyphonic cable sends one value per channel in the same message

outputs.text: Sends a pulse whenever a message arrives on that channel's address
Carries the value of the last message that arrived on that channel's address, with as many channels as the message had values

notes: nothing is sent or received until the addresses and ports are typed into the configuration screen and the connection is turned on
expanders add more channels: input expanders to the left of the module, output expanders to the right, and the arrow buttons reach them
menu: Send Frequency (Hz) — how often an untriggered channel sends its value: 100, 120, 240, 300, 500 or 1000
Change Threshold — how far a voltage has to move before an untriggered channel sends it: 0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01 or 0.05
